featuredArticle.title: AI Lead Scoring for Aged Lists: Rank Your Buy List Before You Dial
featuredArticle.spotlight: Most operations dial aged leads in the order they arrived — the slowest possible path to revenue. This weighted scoring model, augmented with AI for messier signals, can double your contact-to-conversion rate by prioritizing your highest-probability records first.
